table.retrieve:
SELECT   
	serviceheader.serviceinvcode , 
	serviceheader.serviceocode,
	serviceheader.date , 
	serviceheader.remarks , 
	serviceheader.custcode , 
	serviceheader.salesmancode ,
	serviceheader.headerno,  
	serviceheader.headerinvno,  
	users.username , 
	serviceheader.discperc , 
	serviceheader.flatdisc , 
	serviceheader.misccharges , 
	serviceheader.posted , 
	serviceheader.postdate , 
	serviceheader.serviceinvgstperc , 
	customer.address1 , 
	customer.city, 
	customer.phone ,
	customerbalance = 0,
	aliasname='                     ',
	debitorcredit = ' ',
	serviceheader.originaldate,
	serviceheader.modifiedby,
	serviceheader.postedby,
	serviceheader.saleinvcode	,
	serviceheader.doctcode	,	
	serviceheader.servicecatcode,
	serviceheader.cashreceived,
	patientRegNo=(SELECT P.RegNo FROM Patient P WHERE P.PatientCode=ServiceHeader.PatientCode),
	serviceheader.patientcode,
	PatientBalance=0.00,
	serviceheader.admissioncode,
	GuestRegNo=(SELECT G.RegNo FROM Guest G WHERE G.GuestCode=ServiceHeader.GuestCode),
	ServiceHeader.GuestCode,
	ServiceHeader.GuestCheckInCode,
	GuestBalance=0.00,
	StudentRegNo=(SELECT ST.RegNo FROM Student ST WHERE ST.StudentCode=ServiceHeader.StudentCode),
	ServiceHeader.StudentCode,
	StudentBalance=0.00,
	ChasisNo=(SELECT MV.ChasisNo FROM MotorVehicle MV WHERE MV.MotorVehicleCode=ServiceHeader.MotorVehicleCode),
	ServiceHeader.MotorVehicleCode,

	ServiceHeader.DueDate,
	FullPatientName,
	PatientAge,
	PatientSex,
	PatientRefBy,
	Ref1,
	Ref2,
	ServiceHeader.CashAccCode,
	ServiceHeader.CashTendered,
	ServiceHeader.CashCharged,
	ServiceHeader.CashBack,
	ServiceHeader.InvTotal,
	ServiceHeader.OutStandingAmt,
	ServiceHeader.TokenNo,
	ServiceHeader.ServiceInvTypeCode,
	ServiceHeader.MessageCode,
	ServiceHeader.LockerCode,
	ServiceHeader.SurgeryCode,
	ServiceHeader.SurgeryProcedureCode,
	ServiceHeader.IOLPowerCode,
	ServiceHeader.EyeVisionCode,
	ServiceHeader.DiseaseCode,
	ServiceHeader.Mobile,
	ServiceHeader.Item,
	ServiceHeader.CashierShiftCode
FROM  
	customer , 
	serviceheader, 
	users , 
	accounts  
WHERE 
	( serviceheader.custcode = customer.custcode ) and 
	( users.usercode = serviceheader.salesmancode ) and 
	( serviceheader.custcode = accounts.acccode ) and 
	( ( dbo.serviceheader.serviceinvcode = :ar_SaleInvCode ) )
